sloka: ऊर्मि मालिनम् अक्षोभ्यम् क्षुभ्यन्तम् इव सागरम् ।उपप्लुतम् इव आदित्यम् उक्त अन्Rतम् Rषिम् यथा ॥२-१८-६॥
transliteration: ūrmi mālinam akṣobhyam kṣubhyantam iva sāgaram ।upaplutam iva ādityam ukta anRtam Rṣim yathā ॥2-18-6॥

translations.english: Maharaja (Dasaratha) with his senses dulled had become emaciated due to sorrow and suffering. With an agitated and troubled mind, he was breathing heavily. Although unshakable, he looked agitated like an ocean with successive rows of waves, like the Sun in eclipse, like an ascetic who has uttered falsehood.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार बे सब अन्तःपुरवासिनी महाराज. दशरथ की रानियाँ बत्सरहित गो की तरह पति की निन्दा करती हुई उच्च-स्बर सधे रोने लगीं
